headline: Proposed changes to the noise ordinance, plus ward meetings, a city newsletter, and the city website.
summary: The main item is a resolution to update the noise ordinance. Other items cover neighborhood ward meetings hosted by the council, a council newsletter, and improvements to the city website.
items: Resolution to update the noise ordinance (26-138)
Resolution to improve the city website (26-169)
Resolution to schedule neighborhood ward meetings hosted by City Council (26-024)
Resolution to publish City Council newsletter (24-354)
location: City Council Chamber, 2nd Floor, Medford City Hall, 85 George P. Hassett Drive, Medford, MA, and via Zoom
